audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was marked Skill and Levels 2 and 3 were given to Jax, while whys[0] says 'She owns level 1', whys[1] says 'Still hers at 2', whys[2] says 'She edges level 3', and content.early opens with 'Levels 1-3 are hers.'
audit.why: The packet levelChart and the mirror audit agree on Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Jax / Jax. Jax has no Counter Strike until 3 and no answer to her Q-dash-plus-vital pattern before then.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 3 Fiora, Levels 4-5 and 6 Skill, first item and two items Jax.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might', and the level-6 row claims his stats win every extended duel on a row that is genuinely even.
audit.why: Grand Challenge is 110s at rank 1 — the same cooldown as Grandmaster at Arms — and it heals her and amps the vital true damage, which is why 6 is a coinflip rather than a Jax spike. The mirror audit already listed the correct cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (110/100/90). Fiora's spikes: Riposte online, level 6 Grand Challenge (110s at rank 1). Jax's: Counter Strike at 3, Trinity Force, and the two-item duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer reduces Riposte to 'parries your autos' and never states the part that reverses the duel.
audit.why: Riposte (24s at rank 1) parries all incoming damage and disables, and if it blocks an immobilising effect the follow-up stab STUNS instead of slowing. Counter Strike's recast is exactly such an effect, so throwing the stun into an up Riposte both wastes a 17s cooldown and hands her a stun on you. Held correctly, Counter Strike dodges the autos her Vital procs ride on.
audit.corrected: Never throw the E-stun or an Empowered auto into an up Riposte — blocking your stun upgrades her stab from a slow to a stun. Bait it with a throwaway cast, then commit inside its 24s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The flagged suspectName is a false positive.
audit.why: 'Hold Counter Strike' is the real name with a verb attached.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: She owns level 1 — her Q-dash and a vital chip you while you hold only Leap Strike and no Counter Strike yet.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Fiora's Riposte is down.
edits.after: Still hers at 2 — her vital pressure plus an up Riposte beat your Empowered-auto trade, so don't step up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Fiora must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: She edges 3 even as Counter Strike arrives — Riposte (24s) still parries your committed cast and stuns you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Genuinely even now — you hold E for her vital chase to dodge-and-stun, she holds Riposte for your big cast; the read wins it.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R's Armor/MR steroid survives her burst, but Grand Challenge heals her and amps the vital true damage — a coinflip.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force is your spike — a baited-Riposte all-in is your cleanest kill window.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, your resists steroid and attack-speed ramp out-grind her — once Riposte is down, the duel is yours.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your autos. Don’t auto into it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1; bait it with a throwaway cast, never your E-stun. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries your autos. Don’t auto into it. When it is down — Q-E-W her.
edits.after: Riposte parries your autos and, if it blocks your E-stun, upgrades her stab into a stun on you.

edits.before: Hold E until Fiora commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Hold E for her Q-dash in: the dodge eats the autos her vital rides on, and the recast stuns her mid-commit.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Blocking your Counter Strike stun turns her Riposte stab into a stun on you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Vitals are percent-max-HP true damage — keep moving off the cardinal.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Fiora carry threat: 10/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Fiora carry threat: 10/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

notes: Three chart rows flipped as one atomic full/content group, matching the packet, the mirror and this page's own early text. The content layer here is one of the strongest in the slice and was left alone. The full layer's key omission, now stated: Riposte does not merely parry — blocking an immobilising effect upgrades her stab from a slow to a stun, which is precisely what happens when a Jax throws the Counter Strike recast into it.
